idiom_name: enum tag + union payload + switch over the tag, checked by -Wswitch / -Werror=switch
implementation_notes: C has no variant type and no match expression, so the closed set is hand-built: an enum tag plus a union payload (an anonymous union since C11 lets the payload members sit directly in the struct), with every operation dispatching through switch (ev.kind). The compiler check comes from -Wswitch, which is enabled by -Wall, and from -Wswitch-enum: a switch over an enumerated type that omits one of its enumerators is diagnosed, so -Werror=switch turns a new enumerator into build failures at every dispatch site. The classic structure is never replaced here - it is written out by hand - and for a variant set with no payload a plain if on the tag is simpler.
pitfalls: A default: label suppresses -Wswitch entirely, so the exhaustiveness check disappears exactly where someone tried to write defensively; omit it and let the compiler prove coverage.
C cannot tie the tag to the union: reading ev.click while kind == EV_KEY reinterprets the wrong member. Build values through per-variant factory functions and read them only inside the switch.
A union does not destroy its previous member, so assigning a different variant over struct or pointer payloads leaks or corrupts unless the active member is released first.
